query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

messages.content: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

message.content:
You can buy the **latest iPhone** directly from **Apple** online or at an **Apple Store**; Apple says it’s the best place to buy a new iPhone and offers carrier support, payment options, trade-in, and setup help.[1][3]

Other major retailers and carriers also sell the newest iPhone models, including **AT&T**, **Verizon**, **Target**, **Best Buy**, **Walmart**, and **Metro by T-Mobile**.[2][4][5][6][7][8]

- **Apple**: best option if you want an unlocked iPhone and official support.[1]
- **Carrier stores**: useful if you want financing or trade-in deals, such as **AT&T** or **Verizon**.[4][6]
- **Retailers**: **Best Buy**, **Target**, **Walmart**, and **Metro by T-Mobile** also list current models.[2][5][7][8]

If you want, I can help you compare the **best place to buy** based on whether you want the **cheapest price**, **unlocked phone**, or **carrier deal**.
